note: LEADS.md S6 (radiance RADIANCE_GDN_STATE_F16: KL +0.9..+1.1%, their number) reduced to the snapshot, coded on lead/S6-S9-S12 and lead/S6-S12-followup, NOT RUN. STRATA_SNAP_STATE_F16=1: a checkpoint's recurrent state is STORED as the compact FP16 blob (include/strata/core/gdn_state_f16.hpp; RAM copy, disk image with a header format flag, streamed disk blocks; host tests gdn_state_f16_test and gdn_snap_blob_test: relative error <= 2^-11 per value, about half the bytes) and decoded on restore, so this spec measures the QUALITY, the encode / decode cost and the size saving. A one-shot abtest case never restores a checkpoint, so the abtest part is only a no-regression check; the part that matters is the returning conversation: python3 tools/pancake/replay_turns.py bench/specs/257-snap-state-f16.json --out bench/results/<day>-257-snap-state-f16 (the 2026-11-09 agent session of spec 128, same replay block), then python3 tools/pancake/quality_gate.py on the plus-snap-f16 arm (token forcing after a restore) and tools/pancake/task_gate.py. Snapshot size to take with it: the engine log's park / restore lines with STRATA_TRACE=1 and tools/pancake/state_cost.py on the base arm (MOD_PLAN.md section 6: about 111-118 MiB per GDN state; half of that is the saving a compact store would give). STRATA_PARK_VRAM_MIB and STRATA_CKPT_VRAM_SLOTS / STRATA_CKPT_ASYNC give no benefit with the switch on: a checkpoint takes the synchronous path (device to host FP32, encode) and the VRAM slot is not used, because a slot would hold FP32 (leave them unset in both arms). The save adds a host encode of about 111-118 MiB (not measured): read the 'save' time in the STRATA_PARK_TRACE log against base. Stop pancake.service first. NOT run on the busy flag-screen box.
